newsitem.title: USA: BG&E sees Md. nuke likely restarting Tues.
newsitem.headline: BG&E sees Md. nuke likely restarting Tues.

text.p: Baltimore Gas and Electric Co's 850 megawatt (MW) Calvert Cliffs 2 nuclear unit, which automatically shut down this weekend, is expected to restart Tuesday, the company said Monday.
The Lusby, Md., unit shut down due to a problem in a feedwater regulating valve, company spokesman Karl Neddenien said.
"We've identified the problem. We have spare parts on their way," he said, noting the replacement parts are expected to arrive around 1200 EST.
Following repairs, the company will most likely begin startup operations on Tuesday.
